description: 据当前原500记录和每页10条，跟实际UI第50末页；不误把旧155静态阈值当合法现分页范围
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from urllib.parse import urljoin
import json,hashlib,re,requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
base=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_original_archive_route_probe_v1')
prev=json.loads((base/'第三原历史发布目录实际读取.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
raw=Path(prev['path']).read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==prev['sha256']
text=raw.decode('utf-8-sig',errors='replace')
record=re.search(r'var\s+m_nRecordCount\s*=\s*"(\d+)"',text)
pagesize=re.search(r'var\s+m_nPageSize\s*=\s*(\d+)',text)
filename=re.search(r'var\s+m_sPageName\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"',text)
extension=re.search(r'var\s+m_sPageExt\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"',text)
assert record and pagesize and filename and extension
total=int(record.group(1));size=int(pagesize.group(1));maxpage=(total+size-1)//size
assert total==500 and size==10 and maxpage==50
assert 'if(_iPage>_maxPage)' in text and '(_iPage-1)' in text
url=urljoin(prev['final_url'],f'{filename.group(1)}_{maxpage-1}.{extension.group(1)}')
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
ledger=base/'实际原公开导航GET账本.jsonl'
events=[json.loads(x) for x in ledger.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]
assert len([x for x in events if x['event']=='REQUEST_STARTED'])==3
assert url not in [x['url'] for x in events if x['event']=='REQUEST_STARTED']
def trace(x):
 with ledger.open('a',encoding='utf-8') as f:f.write(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n');f.flush()
out={'requested_url':url,'started_at':now(),'actual_original_GET_index':4,'raw_GET_retries':0,'actual_original_pagination_contract':{'m_nRecordCount':total,'m_nPageSize':size,'actual_UI_max_page':maxpage,'raw_general_155_static_ceiling_not_UI_range':'go先按_maxPage夹住；本页实际500/10只50页，不把155当现UI有效范围','raw_root_sha256':prev['sha256']}}
trace({'at':now(),'event':'REQUEST_STARTED','url':url,'attempt':1})
try:
 r=requests.get(url,timeout=(10,30));p=base/'sources'/'actual_historical_release_catalog_UI_last.html';p.write_bytes(r.content)
 s=BeautifulSoup(r.content.decode('utf-8-sig',errors='replace'),'html.parser');full=s.get_text('\n',strip=True)
 out.update(status_code=r.status_code,final_url=r.url,path=p.as_posix(),sha256=hashlib.sha256(r.content).hexdigest(),bytes=len(r.content),status='BROWSER_CHECK_ONLY' if 'Please enable JavaScript and refresh the page.' in full else ('ORIGINAL_PAGE' if r.status_code==200 else 'HTTP_FAILED'),full_text=full)
 out['all_actual_links']=[{'text':a.get_text(' ',strip=True),'raw_href':a['href'],'absolute_url':urljoin(r.url,a['href']),'parent_original':a.parent.get_text(' ',strip=True)} for a in s.select('a[href]')]
except Exception as e:out.update(status='GET_FAILED_NO_RETRY',error_type=type(e).__name__,error=str(e))
out['completed_at']=now();trace({'event':'REQUEST_FINISHED',**{k:v for k,v in out.items() if k not in ['all_actual_links','full_text']}})
p=base/'第四原历史目录实际UI末页读取.json';assert not p.exists();p.write_text(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
articles=[a for a in out.get('all_actual_links',[]) if re.search(r'/t\d{8}_\d+\.html$',a['absolute_url'])]
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in out.items() if k not in ['all_actual_links','full_text']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
print('实际UI末页全文',out.get('full_text','')[:2000],flush=True)
print('实际末页文章',json.dumps(articles,ensure_ascii=False)[:5000],flush=True)
